patch_description: Combines the two best-performing context programs: exact vectorized min-triangle evaluation over all 286 triples, convex-hull-area normalization (so score = min_area / hull_area, matching the metric), multi-seed symmetric inits with time-budgeted restarts, adaptive sigma schedule, and the key recommendation of hybrid move selection — 50% of hill-climb moves perturb a vertex of the current bottleneck (smallest-area) triangle found via argmin over vectorized cross products, 50% are uniform random. Strict acceptance with a small tolerance, deterministic seed.
